definitions.explanation: The act of measuring body temperature, typically with a thermometer. Became an everyday term during the COVID-19 pandemic when temperature checks were required at building entrances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{検温|けんおん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take one's temperature every morning.

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{検温|けんおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please have your temperature checked at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{検温|けんおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: At school, we are required to record the results of our daily temperature checks.

notes:
{検温|けんおん} is the act of measuring body temperature, typically with a thermometer. The word became part of everyday vocabulary during the COVID-19 pandemic.

FORMS:
{検|けん} (examine) + {温|おん} (temperature)

USAGE:
Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {検温|けんおん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take someone's temperature). Common in medical, school, and workplace settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検温|けんおん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a temperature reading
- {検温|けんおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct temperature checks (formal)
- {検温|けんおん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: temperature check results

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧: body temperature
- ⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧: thermometer
- ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧: fever
- ⟦{平熱|へいねつ}→平熱：15477_heinetsu⟧: normal body temperature
